contexts.text: Whatever is proper to man... when presented to view, appears hard... SE 2250.
Such truth... is presented to view... as strong, hard, etc.
The hard way () = falsity.
The good of love to God, and the good of charity towards the neighbour... are, so to speak, not hard and resistant; but as it were soft and yielding.
This sounds harder in the sense of the letter.
Rachel... suffered hard things in her bringing forth () = the temptations of interior truth.
The spiritual man then suffers hard things with the merely natural.
They who are solely in natural good, in the other life suffer hard things...
He spake hard things with them () = hence, also, non-correspondence. Explained.

Hard things with us () = non-conjunction therewith on account of non-correspondence... For, if there is no correspondence of the external with the internal, then everything which is internal... to the external appears hard, because there is no conjunction. Example(s).
Consolation after hard things. Signified, Explained.
These (corporeal Spirits) were seen by me... as it were hard and gross.

And their wrath, for it was hard () = the turning away from truth, that it was confirmed... Hard = things confirmed; for the falsity which is confirmed even to persuasion is hard. That it is hard, has been given me to know from experience; for truth from good with Spirits and Angels appears and is presented as soft; whereas falsity from evil appears and is presented as hard; and so much the harder, as the falsity from evil is the more confirmed. When the persuasion has taken place through confirmation by many things, the hardness appears there as the hardness of bone. Such hardness is also like the hardness in the world, in that it reflects the rays of light. Thus, when the light of Heaven from the Lord falls into what is hard from the falsity from evil, it is reflected; but when it falls into what is soft from the truth from good, it is received.
The hard things with man, as the teeth, bones, and cartilages, correspond to the truths and goods of the lowest Natural.
Enemies meet there; and from these they suffer hard things.

They who are in truth... stand erect as if they were hard... Whereas they who are in good are as it were soft... Truth cannot be ordinated into a heavenly form, except by good; hence, in itself, it is hard...
And for hard service () = by infestations from mere falsities.
I will harden the heart of Pharaoh () = obstinacy from the evil of falsity. To harden = obstinacy.
Such (persuasive) truth is represented in the other life as hard...
They who have been in evil of life do not change; they are as it were hard...
For faith without charity is hard and resistant... But charity with faith is yielding and soft...
Moses struck the rock from a hard heart...
They then suffer hard things...
If the affection of evil is in (the speech), it is inwardly hard.
The man then suffers hard things.

The Divine... cannot inflow into a proud heart; that is, into a heart full of the love of self; for this is hard; and is called in the Word stony. But it can inflow into a humble heart; because this is soft...
From a hard and stony heart.

The people, it is hard in neck () = that it does not receive influx from the Lord. Hard in neck = not to receive influx; for by... hard is signified what resists and refuses; thus what does not receive. This people is so called, because they were in externals without an internal...
He only permitted it on account of the hardness of their hearts.
Iron, from which the last age was called, = hard truth without good.
There was a certain Spirit, hard in heart, with whom an Angel spoke... he was melted to tears.
They are in the lowest parts of Heaven, where they sometimes suffer hard things.
That faith alone induces on hearts... hardness, etc.
That the men, who of themselves are hard, might become soft.
That the intelligence of men in itself is... hard, etc.
Men are hard in skin and flesh.
God cannot... look at man with a hard countenance.
They were hard at heart from the falsities imbued in the world.
Both are thrust down into Hell, where the good man suffers hard things.

Therefore, the less hard a man is; that is, the less he has from himself... the more perfect he is; as may be evident from the fibres, which in infants are very soft, but in old men are indurating. Moreover, in the inmost fibres there is nothing but what is fluid, because spiritual; that which is in the composites appears hard.
a. The less pertinacious and hard it is in a man, the more easily is he bent by the Lord...
The love of self is hard; and love to the Divine is soft.
A sword hard, great, and strong () = the extinction of all truth.
There is also a signification of rock from its hardness. Illustrated.

The reason hardness is expressed by a rock, is from the correspondence of a rock with truth from good; for from truth from good there is all power. But when truth acts against falsity from evil, good is blunted; and the truth remaining acts hardly. Illustrated... Moreover, truth without good is hard; but still is brittle.

A king hard in faces () = no truth, but falsity, in their interiors... Hard in faces = the interiors without good; for where there is no there truth is hard... and this truth is falsity in the interiors...
Sons hard in faces () = those who are in truths without good; and, abstractedly, truths without good, which in themselves are falsities...

The affection of truth and good is hardened - obfirmatur, and becomes hard, outwardly, from zeal, when it has combat against falsity and evil; otherwise it could not repel it; but it is not so inwardly.

Those are signified who have persuaded themselves, and strongly persuade others, of falsities; and who do not admit any truth; and therefore they are called... hard in faces and hardened in heart ()... They think and speak solely from the ultimate Sensuous: this Sensuous, when it is kindled with the fire of the love of self, is hard and hardened.
A hard lord () = the evil of falsity.
